kicker: Learner licence bana, phir student gayab
title: Licence test ki date *aap yaad dilao*, student nahi bhoolega.
message:
Hi [naam] 🚗 aapka *DL test [date]* ko hai.
Is hafte 2 practice slot bache hain: *[din] 7 am* ya *[din] 6 pm*?
Test wale route pe hi practice karayenge.
why: student ko test ka darr hai. *Usi route pe practice* ka offer = extra classes bina pitch ke.
caption:
Driving school ka paisa course ke baad bhi hai: test se pehle practice classes. Par student ko yaad dilata kaun hai? 🚗

System:
1️⃣ Admission pe learner licence date note karo
2️⃣ Test se 3 din pehle WhatsApp
3️⃣ 2 fixed practice slots offer karo
4️⃣ Test pass? Review + referral maango

Save karo 🔖
